title: Review Noise Gate
fixture_requirements: A real blocker reachable from the diff, requiring context beyond the changed hunks (the currency path).
At least two decoys: code that looks defective but is a documented intentional contract or deliberate platform workaround.
A configured linter whose output covers at least two style or typing issues present in the diff.
Contribution notes documenting the intentional contracts behind the decoys.
A plausible-but-unreachable concern (preview.js timezone) that tempts speculative reporting.
deterministic_checks: git -C <target-dir> status --porcelain (must be empty before and after a review run)
